paragraphs.text:
You sense Norman’s reluctance, but he grips his rifle and falls 
into step behind you. Together you do your best to follow the 
trail of Sylvia’s abductor.
Attempt a Track roll: if you succeed, go to 188; if you fail, go to 190.
